'''Grelk Micabra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] from the volcanic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor]]. He was a skilled [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] racer during the waning years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], and could often be seen participating in [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop competitions]] in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].<ref name="Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition" />
